messages.name: AUTHENTICATION FAILURE (cause = "synch failure")
messages.notes: Start T3420; Stop T3460; Perform re-synch with HSS

notes: Authentication failure procedure handling synch failure cause
Timer T3460 started by MME on sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
Timer T3420 started by UE on sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE
MME performs re-synchronization with HSS upon receiving synch failure
Timer T3460 stopped when AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE received
